title: Paranormal investigator summons UFO buffs to Scots hotspot
description: Malcolm Robinson, who has written a string of books on the subject, will be tailed by TV cameras at his Bonnybridge 'sky watch' for an upcoming documentary.

title: Do you believe? Cities with the most UFO sightings in Florida
description: Stacker compiled a ranking of cities with the most UFO sightings in Florida using data from the National UFO Reporting Center.

title: Expert explains what to do if you spot a UFO
description: An expert has shared some advice on what to do if you spot a UFO - revealing the apps that can help determine whether it's a genuine sighting or if there is a more Earthly explanation.

title: Congressman Eric Burlison Says US Gov't Has Been 'Doing Some Really Cool Things' at UFO Facility
description: Congressman Eric Burlison described what he witnessed after securing access to a US Government UFO facility following a conversation with a White House staffer.

title: Brazil's 'Chupa-Chupa' Alien Claims and 'Operation Saucer' UFO Investigation Still Mystery Nearly 50 Years Later
description: In 1977, Brazil witnessed mysterious UFO encounters known as 'Chupa-Chupa', involving unexplained injuries and a military investigation which remains unsolved to this day.
